events.event: Former Polhukam minister Mahfud MD urged President Prabowo and MPR leaders to be careful in setting the schedule for choosing Gibran's replacement as Vice President.
events.key_numbers: MPR plenary moved from 2 Dec to 9 Dec 2026 · Mahfud statement 21 Nov 2026 01:01 WIB
events.why_it_matters: Who becomes Indonesia's next Vice President, and how fast, is being decided now.

events.event: The one-week deadline Prabowo gave coalition party leaders at the 13 Nov Bogor Palace meeting to prepare vice-presidential nominee names fell around 20 Nov; parties are to be invited again after his overseas trip.
events.key_numbers: Meeting 13 Nov 2026 · deadline about 1 week · PAN's Zulkifli Hasan says PAN will not field a cadre through 2029 and suggests a Gerindra figure
events.why_it_matters: The coalition's pick for Vice President is expected to emerge from these closed-door talks.

events.event: Polri says the ethics hearing (KKEP) of former Kapolri Listyo Sigit over the alleged illegal wiretapping of President Prabowo will be held the following week; exact day and panel not yet announced.
events.key_numbers: Hearing 'next week' per Polri spokesperson (reported 17 Nov 2026) · Irjen Ahrie Sonta already given PTDH (dishonourable discharge) in a related case · Sigit named a suspect
events.why_it_matters: A former national police chief faces possible dismissal, a first for Polri.
events.spreading_evidence: Multiple outlets covering; date given is approximate (week of 23 Nov)

events.event: A legal observer said the newly passed Asset Forfeiture Law would let the state seize crime-derived assets even if moved to family or companies, and noted some provisions could be challenged at the Constitutional Court.
events.key_numbers: Passed by DPR plenary 19 Nov 2026 · reportedly takes effect about 1 year after passage · protects good-faith third parties
events.why_it_matters: Corruptors could lose their loot, not just serve prison time, once the law is in force.

events.event: KPK questioned BNPB Secretary-General Rustian again as a witness in the disaster emergency-fund (DSP) corruption case, probing direct appointment of private vendors and kickbacks.
events.key_numbers: 5 suspects · alleged bribes Rp 4.8 billion + 325 grams of gold + SGD/USD sums · earlier 7-hour examination on 27 Oct 2026
events.why_it_matters: Money meant for disaster victims is alleged to have gone to favoured vendors.

events.event: KPK questioned Tanjung Emas (Semarang) customs office head Khoirul Hadziq as a witness in the Bea Cukai import bribery case, asking about a seized container.
events.key_numbers: 8 suspects total · BlueRay Cargo allegedly paid about Rp 61.9 billion to customs officials Jul 2025-Jan 2026 · Rp 3.25 billion to suspect Gatot Heroe Hernanda · verdicts so far: ex-director Rizal 9 years
events.why_it_matters: Shows how import routes were allegedly bought inside customs, raising prices and smuggling risk.
